look: XORA site look, same as the V00 welcome film: deep void ground, frosted glass panels with thin cyan-to-violet edges, fictional market lines drawing in, calm eased motion, the brain tutor guiding from the bottom-right corner

scenes.name: Lesson eight
scenes.desc: Title card: Phase 2, lesson T08, Stop-Loss and Take-Profit; the tutor walks in.

scenes.name: When do you get out?
scenes.desc: A long position falls with no plan; the loss meter keeps growing while the trader freezes.

scenes.name: A trade plan
scenes.desc: Entry, stop-loss and take-profit lines draw onto a fictional chart; for a short the lines flip.

scenes.name: Stop-loss
scenes.desc: Stop-loss defined; price falls to 59,400 and the PnL meter stops at about −6 USDT before fees.

scenes.name: Take-profit
scenes.desc: Take-profit defined; price rises to 61,200 and the PnL meter stops at about +12 USDT before fees.

scenes.name: Trigger and execution
scenes.desc: Trigger price 59,400 versus execution price 59,380; the loss becomes −6.20 USDT.

scenes.name: Risk/reward ratio
scenes.desc: Risk 6 USDT and reward 12 USDT shown as bars; ratio 1 to 2, before fees, not a win chance.

scenes.name: Scenario: price rises
scenes.desc: Price climbs to the take-profit; it triggers and fills; the stop-loss is cancelled.

scenes.name: Scenario: price falls
scenes.desc: Price falls to the stop-loss; it fills at 59,390 for about −6.10 USDT.

scenes.name: Scenario: a gap
scenes.desc: Price gaps from 59,700 to 59,100; the stop fills there for about −9 USDT.

scenes.name: Target missed
scenes.desc: Price reaches 61,150, turns down, and the unfilled take-profit leaves the unrealized gain to shrink.

scenes.name: Common mistake
scenes.desc: The belief that risk/reward is a win chance is corrected with ten fictional trades.

scenes.name: Try it
scenes.desc: Pause and work out risk, reward and ratio for a plan; the answer 5, 10, 1 to 2 is revealed.

scenes.name: Know the limits
scenes.desc: Stops slip, targets can be missed, liquidation can come first with leverage, and waiting is allowed.

scenes.name: Recap
scenes.desc: Three key points and one question to check yourself.

scenes.name: Up next
scenes.desc: End card: next lesson T09, fees, spread and slippage.
